verdict.rationale: Glama ships a built-in chat product that gives access to leading models. Users can hand it concrete tasks such as answering questions over uploaded documents or turning text into diagrams, so a first-party in-product assistant exists. However, nothing shows that assistant carrying out agentic, multi-step work or acting on the user's Glama resources (servers, gateway, hosting). missing for 10: evidence of agentic task execution beyond chat responses, assistant acting on in-product resources, independent or hands-on corroboration of the chat assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Access every leading model with a single account. Same familiar UI, powerful features, no limits.
Upload any PDF, Word doc, or text file. Get instant answers with exact page references.
Transform text descriptions into professional diagrams.
